provenance: synthetic — the 11x class described in OS#428
why: Every test in the new module is red against the unfixed tree for one reason only: pkg.services.quota does not exist yet, so the import fails. An ImportError red proves the module is new, not that the guard bites. Nothing tests the line that actually changed behaviour — the check_quota call added to export_rows — so deleting that call leaves the suite green.
